primary_sources: Pazos M, Traverso CE, Viswanathan A; European Glaucoma Society. Terminology and guidelines for glaucoma, 6th edition. Br J Ophthalmol 2025;109(Suppl 1):1-212
Gedde SJ, Vinod K, Wright MM, et al. Primary open-angle glaucoma preferred practice pattern. Ophthalmology 2021;128(1S):P71-P150
Ehlers N, Bramsen T, Sperling S. Applanation tonometry and central corneal thickness. Acta Ophthalmol 1975;53(1):34-43

rules.name: Goldmann-Ehlers linear correction
rules.source: Ehlers N, Bramsen T, Sperling S. Acta Ophthalmol 1975;53(1):34-43
rules.specification: Applies linear adjustment to measured IOP based on central corneal thickness (CCT) deviation from reference value of 540 microns, at a rate of 1 mmHg per 25 microns of deviation
rules.implementation_note: Reference value 540 microns and factor 25 are the canonical Ehlers parameters. The function does not account for individual corneal biomechanical properties (hysteresis, rigidity).

rules.name: CCT category labelling
rules.specification: Classifies CCT into three categorical labels for downstream interpretation
rules.implementation_note: Three-tier classification preserved across the suite to enable consistent CCT-aware adjustments in M2 and disclosure flags in M5.

rules.name: Adjustment magnitude impact class
rules.specification: Categorizes the magnitude of the IOP adjustment into four impact classes for clinician interpretation
rules.implementation_note: Design-derived thresholds chosen to align with how clinicians intuitively assess the practical relevance of CCT-based adjustments.

rules.name: Extreme CCT caution flagging
rules.source: OHTS findings (Gordon et al. 2002) cited in EGS 2025
rules.specification: Sets caution flag when CCT is in extreme ranges, indicating that the linear correction may be less reliable and requires additional clinical context
rules.implementation_note: Caution flag is non-blocking; the adjusted IOP is still computed but accompanied by an explicit warning. OHTS identified extreme CCT as an independent risk factor for glaucoma development.

rules.name: Confidence level derivation
rules.specification: Assigns confidence level based on impact class and presence of caution flags
logic: If impact_class is 'negligible' or 'minor' AND no caution flags: confidence = 'high'
If impact_class is 'relevant' OR caution flags present: confidence = 'moderate'
If impact_class is 'significant' AND extreme_thin or extreme_thick caution: confidence = 'low'
rules.implementation_note: Confidence is propagated to M5 as one of the inputs determining the integrated confidence level.
